enough_info.meaning: Enough basic information for a customer to assess a provider, not enough to automatically confirm a booking.
yes_requires: A supported provider offer to visit
A clear visit day resolved against the case call date
A supported useful arrival period: exact time, a time window, morning, afternoon, evening, night, or after lunch
A clear applicable visit/inspection fee or total-job quote, including an explicitly free inspection
not_required: An exact clock time when a clear arrival period is available
A separate visit fee when a clear total-job quote is available
A fixed repair price when only an inspection is being offered
no_when: Only a day is given without any useful arrival period
The day or arrival period is withdrawn, tentative, contradicted, or not clearly accepted
Only a customer budget, unrelated transaction, historical rate, arithmetic example, or withdrawn quote supplies the amount
The applicable fee depends on unresolved eligibility or another unknown condition
The provider declines the work or does not make a clear visit offer
enough_info.fee_rule: Keep visit fees, separate repair prices and combined totals distinct. A clear total-job estimate can qualify, but preserve its estimated nature and inclusions. Never relabel a combined quote as a visit fee or invent a repair amount by subtraction. An inspection fee credited or waived when work is done can qualify if that condition is clear. Zero is a known fee, not missing data.
enough_info.date_rule: Resolve relative dates using the supplied call date in Asia/Kolkata. Do not silently fix contradictory dates or unusual explicit years.
enough_info.exact_fields_rule: Keep visit_time null for a broad period or window even when enough_info is yes. Keep visit_fee null if only a combined job total is quoted. This policy does not alter extraction facts to make a case qualify.
enough_info.uncertainty_rule: Assistant-authored labels still require human review. A yes on a case marked needs_adjudication is provisional, not approved ground truth.
enough_info.scope: Evaluation labels only. No change to database, production extraction prompt, UI selection eligibility, call permissions, or booking confirmation.

policy.numeric_rule: Never convert combined totals to separate repair fees or infer a repair amount by subtraction. Separate conditional labour estimates may be captured with their caveats. General prices for other jobs are not quotes.
policy.answered_rule: An answered but unclear/disconnected call is not no_answer. offer_received may have missing fields; use needs_clarification if willingness itself is tentative or unclear.
policy.evidence_rule: Evidence excerpts must be exact provider text. Explicit clear provider confirmation may support the immediately preceding agent recap, but garbled or unrelated speech does not.
policy.text_scoring: Compare summary, fee_covers, repair_cost_notes and availability_as_said semantically; do not require exact wording. Evidence must be an exact provider quote; valid supporting quote sets may differ.
policy.label_limit: Assistant-authored reference labels, not independently verified ground truth. Human approval is pending for all cases. needs_adjudication marks material ambiguities requiring explicit review before strict scoring. Do not use old extracted database fields as truth.
